message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded datasets before processing; column renaming is the only structural adjustment made.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local filesystem path (Path('./datasets')) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation steps only include imputation, normalization, encoding, and train/test splitting; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering routines.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using scikit-learn estimators and does not load any serialized/pretrained model files, so there is no integrity verification (hash check, signature, etc.) in place.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library or mechanism (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: The Dash app accepts numeric inputs from users and passes them directly through normalization and encoding to the model without any range checks, shape validation, or schema enforcement.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are returned and displayed without any checks for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds on the inference output.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a tabular ML classifier (Random Forest, KNN, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
